### Executive Summary
Financial technology company Revolut has confirmed a customer data breach resulting from fraudulent requests. The security incident occurred after the organization fell for fake government data requests submitted by unauthorized parties.

The exact number of affected users, full timeline of the breach, and specific categories of compromised customer data are not yet confirmed.

### Technical Impact & Root Cause
The root cause of the breach was a social engineering tactic in which threat actors masqueraded as government entities to issue fraudulent data requests, which were subsequently fulfilled by Revolut. 

The technical impact involves the unauthorized disclosure and exposure of customer data. Further technical details regarding specific system access, attack infrastructure, or internal vectors are not yet confirmed in the source material.

### Mitigation & IOCs
Specific mitigation measures implemented by Revolut following the incident have not been disclosed in the provided source. Organizations facing similar risks are advised to establish strict out-of-band validation protocols for processing emergency and law enforcement data requests.
